poste.name: La poste · The Post Office
poste.alt: A sunny yellow post office hall with blue woodwork. On the left the front doorway stands open in its blue frame, a bicycle outside; inside are a yellow post box, a girl writing an address on a big white envelope and an explorer setting down his expedition crate. A red door stands in the back wall. On the right a postman holds up a string-tied packet, a man leaps back in shock as a parcel thumps to the floor, a striped flag stands on its pole, a courier's mail bag bulges with letters, a telegraph machine curls out its tape, and a giant stamp of a tree hangs on a timber log beside a blue door.

guichet.name: Le guichet · The Counter Window
guichet.alt: The post office counter room: on the left a red door, a window, a bench and a potted plant. On the right, behind a barred counter window, a smiling clerk in a blue cap punches a wooden date stamp onto a letter. On the counter sit a tray of exchange coins, a roll of brown wrapping paper and a pink potion dripping through a coffee filter. A woman waves her form, a man slides his letter across, and an envoy in a red sash carries a sealed letter. In front, a collie dog sits beside a big parcel.

doors.label: la poste
doors.hint: Go back through the red door to the post office hall

cour.name: La cour de livraison · The Delivery Yard
cour.alt: The sunny cobbled yard behind the yellow post office. Against the wall a postwoman drops letters into three wooden letterboxes above a sorting tray split by a partition. A boy by his bicycle leaves a box of raisins at the blue door, two girls hand over a parcel, and a little fenced vegetable plot grows in the corner. A red postal van is parked in the middle, with a lawn, a stone wall and a big tree on the right.

doors.hint: Go back through the blue door to the post office hall
